fields.name: MissingMods
fields.evidence: Toolkit EoCClient.dll+0xBE4440 ecl::mod::SubscriptionSyncSystem::ProcessMissingSubscriptions clears the set at component+0 (thunk_FUN_180AE0EC0) and inserts (FUN_1801C9060, HashSet insert) the publish handle of each subscribed UGC mod that is not among ls::ModManager::GetAvailableMods. Live: empty.

fields.name: SyncedMods
fields.evidence: ProcessPendingSubscriptions (EoCClient.dll+0xBE5240) clears component+0x30 and inserts the last pending publish handle when ls::ModManager::HasModWithPublishHandle is true. Live: empty.

fields.name: PendingMods
fields.evidence: ls::DynamicArray<unsigned __int64> at +0x60 (size +0x6C): ProcessMissingSubscriptions appends Module::GetPublishHandle values not yet in it; ProcessPendingSubscriptions takes the last one and RemoveLast()s it. Live: empty.

fields.name: LastSyncTime
fields.evidence: ProcessPendingSubscriptions processes one pending mod only when GameTime.Time - *(double*)(component+0x70) >= 2.0 and then stores the current game time there. macOS default: str xzr [x23,#0x70]; live 0.
